The '''Pluthan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], near the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]]. It contained the [[Pluthan asteroid belt]].

==History==
After the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|rise]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Krova (Hutt)|Krova]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was captured by the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Langro Dis]] in the Pluthan system, near the [[Pluthan asteroid belt]]. The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] was then brought to [[Alvorine]] for trial.<ref name="THH" />
